svg.text: PostgreSQL → Data API → scheduled sync (07:00 & 19:00) → always up-to-date chatbot answers
twice a day automatically, or on demand
app calls us after a change
Saved in the jobs table: one sync at a time
Survives restarts; status visible in admin
only what changed since the last successful sync
build a new version beside the live one; switch only if it passes
users see new data; the team sees every run
Clear cached answers of that product
Alert: failure or no sync in 24 h
fail → keep current index + alert the team
Every step is logged; a failed run never changes what users see - the chatbot keeps answering from the last good version.
